card.fires_on: The pole responds to a middle piece of a longer word, mostly the "yper" in antihyperglycemic, and also pieces of capitalized brand names (MOTOFEN, BESPONSA, OPTIGUIDE) and OVERDOSAGE. It also fires on "Monitor" after a drug-interaction list.

modes.label: The word Monitor after a drug list
